sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(u.value), SUM(u.value) FROM records, UNNEST(samples) AS u
flat_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(value), SUM(value) FROM flat

sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(u.value) FROM records LEFT JOIN UNNEST(samples) AS u ON TRUE
flat_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(value) FROM flat

sql: SELECT record_id, u.value, u.ordinality FROM records CROSS JOIN UNNEST(samples) WITH ORDINALITY AS u ORDER BY record_id, ordinality LIMIT 25
flat_sql: SELECT record_id, value, pos FROM flat ORDER BY record_id, pos LIMIT 25

sql: SELECT record_id, v, pos FROM records r INNER JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(r.samples) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(v,pos) ON v > r.record_id ORDER BY record_id, pos LIMIT 25
flat_sql: SELECT record_id, value, pos FROM flat WHERE value > record_id ORDER BY record_id, pos LIMIT 25

sql: SELECT record_id, v, pos FROM records LEFT JOIN UNNEST(samples) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(v,pos) ON v > 2 ORDER BY record_id, pos LIMIT 25
flat_sql: SELECT record_id, value, pos FROM flat ORDER BY record_id, pos LIMIT 25

sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(u.value) FROM records LEFT JOIN UNNEST(samples) AS u ON TRUE WHERE u.value > 2
flat_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(value) FROM flat WHERE value > 2

sql: SELECT u.value, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(record_id) FROM records, UNNEST(samples) AS u GROUP BY u.value HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY value NULLS FIRST
flat_sql: SELECT value, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(record_id) FROM flat GROUP BY value HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY value NULLS FIRST

sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.value FROM records, UNNEST(samples) AS u ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST
flat_sql: SELECT DISTINCT value FROM flat ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST

sql: SELECT COUNT(u.value.price), SUM(u.value.price) FROM records, UNNEST(items) AS u
flat_sql: SELECT COUNT(price), SUM(price) FROM flat

sql: SELECT record_id, u.value, u.ordinality FROM records, UNNEST(items) WITH ORDINALITY AS u ORDER BY record_id, ordinality LIMIT 25

SELECT record_id, u.ordinality AS item_pos, v.value AS tag, v.ordinality AS pos FROM records, UNNEST(items) WITH ORDINALITY AS u LEFT JOIN UNNEST(u.value.tags) WITH ORDINALITY AS v ON TRUE ORDER BY record_id, item_pos, pos LIMIT 25
flat_sql: SELECT record_id, item_pos, tag, pos FROM flat ORDER BY record_id, item_pos, pos LIMIT 25

sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(v.value), SUM(v.value) FROM records, UNNEST(matrix) AS u, UNNEST(u.value) AS v
flat_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(value), SUM(value) FROM flat

sql: SELECT record_id, u.ordinality AS outer_pos, v.value, v.ordinality AS pos FROM records LEFT JOIN UNNEST(matrix) WITH ORDINALITY AS u ON TRUE LEFT JOIN UNNEST(u.value) WITH ORDINALITY AS v ON TRUE ORDER BY record_id, outer_pos, pos LIMIT 25
flat_sql: SELECT record_id, outer_pos, value, pos FROM flat ORDER BY record_id, outer_pos, pos LIMIT 25

sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(u.value) FROM records, UNNEST(large_values) AS u
flat_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(value) FROM flat

sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(u.value) FROM records, UNNEST(samples) AS u, UNNEST(items) AS v
flat_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(value) FROM flat

sql: SELECT record_id, SUM(v.value) AS total FROM records, UNNEST(matrix) AS u, UNNEST(u.value) AS v GROUP BY record_id HAVING SUM(v.value) > 1 ORDER BY record_id LIMIT 25
flat_sql: SELECT record_id, SUM(value) AS total FROM flat GROUP BY record_id HAVING SUM(value) > 1 ORDER BY record_id LIMIT 25

sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(u.value) FROM records, UNNEST(samples) AS u WHERE record_id < 2
flat_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(value) FROM flat WHERE record_id < 2

sql: SELECT record_id, u.value, u.ordinality FROM records, UNNEST(samples) WITH ORDINALITY AS u LIMIT 25 OFFSET 3
flat_sql: SELECT record_id, value, pos FROM flat LIMIT 25 OFFSET 3

sql: SELECT u.value.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM records, UNNEST(items) AS u GROUP BY u.value.name ORDER BY name NULLS FIRST
flat_sql: SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM flat GROUP BY name ORDER BY name NULLS FIRST

sql: SELECT record_id, u.value, u.ordinality FROM records, UNNEST(matrix) WITH ORDINALITY AS u ORDER BY record_id, ordinality LIMIT 25
SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(u.value), SUM(u.value) FROM records, UNNEST(fixed_values) AS u
flat_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(value), SUM(value) FROM flat

sql: SELECT record_id, u.value, u.ordinality FROM records, UNNEST(fixed_values) WITH ORDINALITY AS u WHERE u.ordinality = 3 OR u.value IS NULL ORDER BY record_id, ordinality LIMIT 25
flat_sql: SELECT record_id, value, pos FROM flat WHERE pos = 3 OR value IS NULL ORDER BY record_id, pos LIMIT 25
